messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — inference-gateway-prod: 5xx spike (502/504) across multiple zones (eu-west-1 most impacted). Auto-escalation -> oncall Sara.
Sara (on-call): On it. seeing elevated 502s in gateway logs, starting triage.
Sara (on-call): Quick metric: error rate ~28% last 5m, p95 latency +2s. Top downstream: model-runner-v2 shards returning 5xx.
Mike (Infra): I can see a burst of pod evictions on model-runner nodes, kube events show OOMKills + segfault-restarts.
Raj (SRE): paste of recent model-runner logs:
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:10Z] model-runner[pid=8]: runtime error: segfault at 0x7ff.. in attention_kernel
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] model-runner[pid=8]: Received signal 11 (SIGSEGV) - crashing
[2026-03-17T14:02:11Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 8 (model-runner) score 987
[2026-03-17T14:02:12Z] kubernetes: ContainerExited code=137 -> restarting
```
Sara (on-call): That matches the OOM/segfault hypothesis. Probably kv-cache growth + large batch. Any recent rollout?
Mike (Infra): No prod model rollouts in last 2h. We did push a runtime lib patch ~6h ago but no change flagged.
Raj (SRE): Repro on a canary: forcing a long sequence + batch of 16 recreated the segfault locally — looks like attention kernel path with quantized kernels under memory pressure.
Lisa (Support): ETA on mitigation? Customers reporting 502s on chat; I need an interim message.
Sara (on-call): Immediate mitigations I'm going to execute now: 1) Scale up model-runner pool + add headroom 2) Enable fallback routing to model-runner-v1 (lower mem variant) for non-SLA tenants 3) Temporarily reduce max batch size to 4 at gateway level.
Raj (SRE): Agree. Also suggest disabling kv-cache writes for affected shards to slow growth: set `kv_cache.enabled=false` on those nodes.
Mike (Infra): K8s ops: scaling model-runner pool +2 nodes (gpu-pool-3). Running: `kubectl scale deployment/model-runner --replicas=12 -n prod`
Mike (Infra): Scaling initiated — new nodes should register in ~90s.
Sara (on-call): Gateway rule change to reduce batch size: `PATCH /config/gateway` -> `max_batch_size: 4` (rolling deploy). Applying now.
Sara (on-call): Routing: enabling fallback route for non-enterprise tenants to model-runner-v1 (quantized small). Command: `redwood route set --from inference-gateway-prod --to model-runner-v1 --weight 30% --filter non-sla`
Raj (SRE): Starting kv-cache toggle on impacted shards: `rdctl shard update --shard shard-17 --kv-cache=false` (doing in parallel across three hot shards).
CustomerOps (bot): Notifying customers tagged as impacted in eu-west-1 with template message: "We’re seeing transient 502s; mitigation in progress; updates in #incidents."
Lisa (Support): I posted initial message to impacted customers and support queue. Keeping them updated.
Sara (on-call): Observability: enabling verbose model-runner tracing for 20m on scaled nodes to capture stack traces if crash recurs.
Raj (SRE): I collected a core dump from one crashed pod and uploaded to `/tmp/cores/model-runner-8.core`. Will analyze after stabilization.
Mike (Infra): New pods are Ready, some older crashed pods still restarting but crash rate dropped ~10m after scaling + batch reduction.
Sara (on-call): Early numbers: error rate down from 28% -> 9% in 10m. Latency p95 trending back toward baseline.
Lisa (Support): Sharing update to customers: "We’ve implemented fallback routing and reduced batching to mitigate the failures. Some requests may be served by a lower-memory model; quality impact minimal for most workloads."
Raj (SRE): Follow-up plan: roll forward a hotfix for attention kernel, add guard rails for kv-cache growth, add OOM alert on per-shard memory with early throttling.
Sara (on-call): Handoff to Raj for full RCA and fix timeline. Raj, can you own postmortem and timeline?
Raj (SRE): I’ll take it. Will open incident doc with timeline, affected tenants, and proposed fixes.
Sara (on-call): Thanks. Closing active mitigation phase. Please ack when you have the incident doc link and next steps.
Raj (SRE): Ack — creating doc now. Next update in #incidents within 2h.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial) — monitoring.
Lisa (Support): Marking affected customer tickets with status "mitigated - routing fallback enabled".
Sara (on-call): Good work team. Main owner: Raj for RCA, Mike for infra follow-ups, Lisa to continue comms.
